endorsements.name: Natalie Silvanovich
endorsements.label: No Clicks Required: Finding Fully Remote Vulnerabilities in Messaging Applications
endorsements.description: There is increasing evidence that ‘0-click’ or ‘interaction-less’ vulnerabilities in messaging applications are being used by attackers. This talk will discuss how to evaluate a messaging application for fully remote vulnerabilities. Read more
